family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that sorts a list of numbers and finds the maximum difference between two consecutive values in that sorted order. Return 0 if the list has fewer than 2 elements.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that checks whether a list is the same when reversed, i.e., whether it reads the same forwards and backwards. Return True or False. An empty list is considered a palindrome.
reference:
def is_palindrome_list(lst):
    return lst == lst[::-1]

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that counts local maxima in a list, where an interior element is a local maximum if it is strictly greater than both its neighbors, and an endpoint (first or last element) is a local maximum if it is strictly greater than its single neighbor. A list of exactly one element counts as having one local maximum, and an empty list has zero. Return the count as an integer.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that removes leading and trailing zero values from a list, while keeping any zeros that appear strictly between non-zero elements untouched. Return an empty list if the list is empty or consists entirely of zeros.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that takes a list of numbers and a target value, and finds the smallest index i such that the sum of the elements from the start of the list up to and including index i is strictly greater than the target. Return that smallest index, or -1 if the running sum never exceeds the target.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that computes a running total of a list of numbers, but whenever adding the next element makes the running total negative, the total is reset to 0 at that position instead of being allowed to go negative. Return the list of running totals recorded after each element is processed (and possibly reset), which is empty for an empty input.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that finds the maximal run of consecutive strictly positive numbers with the greatest number of elements, and returns the sum of that run's elements. If multiple runs tie for the greatest length, use the first one encountered. Return 0 if the list has no positive numbers.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that merges two lists that are each already sorted in ascending order into a single sorted ascending list, similar to the merge step of merge sort. Assume both input lists are sorted; ties should take from the first list before the second. Return an empty list if both inputs are empty.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that computes the median of a non-empty list of numbers: if the list has an odd number of elements, return the middle value after sorting; if it has an even number of elements, return the average of the two middle values after sorting, rounded to 1 decimal place.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that shifts the elements of a list to the right by n positions, dropping the last n elements and filling the first n positions with a given fill value; the result has the same length as the input. If n is 0 or negative, return a copy of the list unchanged; if n is at least the length of the list, return a list of the fill value repeated to the original length.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that shifts the elements of a list to the left by n positions, dropping the first n elements and filling the last n positions with a given fill value; the result has the same length as the input. If n is 0 or negative, return a copy of the list unchanged; if n is at least the length of the list, return a list of the fill value repeated to the original length.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that finds the smallest positive integer (1 or greater) that does not appear in a list of integers. The list may contain negatives, zero, duplicates, or be unordered. Return that smallest missing positive integer.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that takes a list of unique integers sorted in ascending order and compresses it into a list of [start, end] pairs, one for each maximal run of consecutive integers (each next value equal to the previous plus one). Return an empty list for an empty input.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that takes a list of [start, end] pairs (each with start less than or equal to end) and expands each pair into all the integers from start to end inclusive, then combines all of them into a single sorted list with duplicates removed (ranges may be unsorted or overlapping in the input). Return an empty list for an empty input.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that finds the maximum product obtainable by multiplying two distinct-position elements from a list of numbers (the list may contain negative numbers, so the best pair might be the two largest or the two most negative values). Assume the list has at least two elements.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that finds the minimum absolute difference between any two distinct-position elements of a list of numbers. Assume the list has at least two elements.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that counts the number of index pairs (i, j) in a list of numbers where i comes before j and the element at i is strictly greater than the element at j (an 'inversion'). Return 0 for a list with fewer than 2 elements.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that takes a list of lists and returns the length of the longest common prefix shared by all of them, where a prefix is common if every list has the same value at each of those leading positions. Return 0 if the outer list is empty or if the lists share no common leading value.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that takes a list and a list of 0-indexed positions to remove, and returns a new list with the elements at those positions removed, preserving the relative order of the remaining elements. The indices list may be unsorted or contain duplicates; any index that is out of range for the list is simply ignored.

family: list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
spec: Write a function that inserts a given item into a list after every `interval` elements (interval is a positive integer), but never adds a trailing item after the very last element of the list. For example, inserting 0 into [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] with interval 2 produces [1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 0, 5]. Return an empty list if the input list is empty.
